# Getting Support for Secure Dialer 📞

Thank you for using **Secure Dialer**! We want to ensure you have a smooth and secure experience.

## ❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Before submitting a request, please check our comprehensive **[FAQ in README.md](../README.md#%EF%B8%8F-frequently-asked-questions-faq)** which answers common questions about:
- Zero-Internet permission & offline sandboxing
- Hardware-backed AES-256 database encryption (SQLCipher & KeyStore)
- Default Phone App setup & Call Screening integration
- Local-first vs System contacts model
- T9 predictive dialing search

---

## 🐞 Reporting Bugs & Requesting Features

If you encounter an unexpected issue or have an idea to improve Secure Dialer:

1. **Search Existing Issues:** Check the **[GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Secure-Phone-apps/Secure-Dialer/issues)** to see if your bug or feature has already been discussed.
2. **Submit an Interactive Form:**
   - **[Report a Bug](https://github.com/Secure-Phone-apps/Secure-Dialer/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)**: Use our interactive form to provide details on your device model, Android version, and reproduction steps.
   - **[Suggest a Feature](https://github.com/Secure-Phone-apps/Secure-Dialer/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)**: Share your ideas for privacy-hardened, offline enhancements.

---

## 🛡️ Security Vulnerability Reporting

If you discover a security flaw or privacy issue, **do not open a public issue**. Please review our **[Security Policy](../SECURITY.md)** for instructions on responsible, confidential disclosure.

---
